name: Death of a Southern Belle
source:
You play as Juliana Williams, a girl who moves to her parent's small town after the death of her grandparents. As she goes through the motions, she notices something...off about the town. But ghosts can't be real, right? 

As she discovers the horrors of what looks like a normal small southern town on the surface, will she uncover the truth? Or will the snake swallow her whole, losing everything in the process? 

[From [url=https://honeymoonie.itch.io/vgd-1002-final]Itch.io[/url]]
